company.name: Dexterity
company.shortDescription: Dexterity provides AI-powered robotic solutions for logistics, warehouses, and supply chains.
company.description: Dexterity offers robots as a service solution for logistics, warehousing, and supply chain operations. The company provides a 'robots as a service' model, which allows businesses to efficiently integrate robotics into their supply chain operations. Dexterity's flagship product, DexR, is a two-armed robot designed for tasks like truck loading, equipped with machine vision and force sensing technologies.
